metadata.title: Chip stocks are suffering from a ‘crisis of confidence’ — but things aren’t as gloomy as they seem - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Chip stocks are suffering from a ‘crisis of confidence’ — but things aren’t as gloomy as they seem
Investors are worried about whether there will be sustained demand for chips, but one analyst notes that large tech companies are still spending heavily
Faith in the artificial-intelligence trade is faltering, but one analyst sees reasons to remain upbeat.
Semiconductor stocks are clearly “suffering a crisis of confidence,” Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon said in a note on Monday. Despite rising 50% on the year as of Friday’s close, the PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX had fallen 30% from its highs in June.
